coverage_note: Kentucky has no comprehensive public-sector bargaining statute in the sources captured. This row covers KRS chapter 345 (firefighters of first-class cities, consolidated local governments and petitioning cities). Separate police statutes were not captured. 2026 HB 888, which would have repealed KRS 345, was last returned to committee on March 25, 2026 per its bill record (captured).

governing_statute.value: No comprehensive statute. KRS chapter 345, Collective Bargaining for Firefighters.
governing_statute.quote: Firefighters of a city of the first class shall have, and shall be protected in the exercise of, the right of self-organization, to form, join, or assist any labor organization, to bargain collectively through representatives of their own choosing on questions of wages, hours, and other conditions of employment

source.publisher: Kentucky General Assembly, Kentucky Revised Statutes
source.title: KRS 345.030
